title: AI-SDLC Lite provider adapter declaration (no execution authority)
description: Declarative, provider-neutral description of what repository records say about a coding-agent provider. It never runs a provider, probes a version, or grants authority. The validator in ai_sdlc/adapters.py reads x-vocabulary as the single source of the allowed names and enforces the rules in x-rules.

observed.description: A historical observed version recorded in the repository, or null. Not a compatibility claim.

capabilities.description: Exactly the capability ids in x-vocabulary.capabilities; each has status, basis, evidence and note.

x-rules.SUPPORTED: previously observed: basis observed and at least one existing evidence file
x-rules.NOT_QUALIFIED: documented or configured but never exercised: basis documented or configuration and at least one existing evidence file
x-rules.UNKNOWN: insufficient evidence: basis none and no evidence
x-rules.UNSUPPORTED: evidence confirms absence: basis observed or documented and at least one existing evidence file
x-rules.evidence: repository-relative regular files inside the project; no absolute paths, traversal, globs or symlinks
x-rules.strings: display-safe text only; control, format, surrogate, private-use, separator (except ASCII space) and replacement characters are rejected
